description: This file defines the class DeleteTestCampaigns, which encapsulates the logic to delete test campaigns and their related records in the SuiteCRM system. It includes the deleteTestRecords method that interacts with database tables such as campaign_log, prospect_lists, and emails to mark test campaign data as deleted.

classes.name: DeleteTestCampaigns
classes.description: A class responsible for deleting test campaigns and associated data within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: deleteTestRecords
methods.description: Deletes test campaign records and related email and campaign log entries for a given Campaign instance.
